verdict.rationale: Natural-language querying of telemetry is a fair axis for an observability platform. However, the pack never documents asking questions in natural language and getting back a real query or chart. The Bits AI and MCP Server items are bare titles with no description of this capability. The ChatGPT Experiments plugin covers experiment analysis, not natural-language-to-telemetry queries or charts, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back
